witness_description: No counterexample can be certified from the supplied data because neither the admissible values of n and k nor the meaning of C(a,b) for a negative top index is defined.
refutation_explanation: The finite sweep verifies the stated integer-index sign conditions on positive candidate values, but the truth of the numerical binomial equality cannot be evaluated without inventing a convention for negative-top binomial coefficients. Consequently, the sweep cannot establish or refute the target claim.
search_space: All 64 ordered integer pairs (n,k) with 1 <= n <= 8 and 1 <= k <= 8, in lexicographic order with n outermost; for each pair, the conditions -k < 0 and, when n+k >= 2, -n-k+1 < 0 were checked exactly. No binomial values were compared because their required negative-top definition is absent.
